note: Read tools execute immediately; run_workflow creates a confirmation ticket. Multi-hop capped by BACKEND_AGENT_MAX_TOOL_HOPS. web_search gated by BACKEND_AGENT_WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED. list_workflow_timers is admin-only.

tools.name: search_layers
tools.description: Search layer catalog by keyword (read-only, ACL filtered).

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List available workflow definitions/templates (read-only). Optional keyword filter.

query.description: Optional keyword matched against workflow id/name/tags

tools.name: get_layer_meta
tools.description: Get detailed metadata for one catalog layer (read-only, ACL filtered): description, readiness, extent, workflow binding, tags.

tools.name: get_workflow_meta
tools.description: Get detailed info for one workflow definition (read-only, ACL): description, engine, node summary, linked layer.

tools.name: sample_layer_point
tools.description: Sample raster/overlay (or weather) value at a map point. Uses args lng/lat, or client_context.map_point if omitted. Optional catalog_id; otherwise samples active layers from client_context.

catalog_id.description: Optional single layer; if omitted sample active layers

time.description: Optional time key (e.g. YYYYMMDD) for time-series overlays

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the public web (DuckDuckGo Instant Answer + Wikipedia fallback) for background knowledge. Not for private/intranet data.

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.description: List recent workflow runs for the current user (admin sees all). Filter by status / active_only / limit.

status.description: Optional status filter e.g. succeeded / failed / running

tools.name: get_workflow_run
tools.description: Get status of one workflow run by run_id (owner-scoped).

tools.name: get_layer_coverage
tools.description: Get dual-channel data coverage for a catalog layer (online window + local dates).

tools.name: list_workflow_timers
tools.description: List workflow timers (admin only). Optional workflow_id filter.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Prepare a workflow-run for a catalog layer. Does NOT submit until the user confirms via confirmation card. Optional time_range (ISO start/end) and workflow_variant=online.

workflow_id.description: Optional workflow seed id; defaults to layer descriptor workflow_id

workflow_variant.description: Use online variant seed when declared on the layer
